display.name: Mixpanel
display.summary: Queries Mixpanel product analytics and manages dashboards for the signed-in US-region organization.
examples: Create a dashboard for these reports.

agent.name: mixpanel
agent.description: Queries Mixpanel events, funnels, flows, retention, reports, and dashboards in the signed-in US-region organization.
agent.owns: You own Mixpanel product analytics and dashboards visible to this account. Discover projects and events before querying. Creating or updating a dashboard requires confirmation. This endpoint is for US-region data; it does not own EU or India-region projects.
agent.first_for: Mixpanel product analytics, reports, and dashboards

tool_descriptions.Run-Query: Run an insights, funnel, flow, or retention query.
tool_descriptions.Get-Query-Schema: Get the JSON schema needed to build an analytics query.
tool_descriptions.Get-Report: Retrieve a saved report, optionally including its results.
tool_descriptions.Get-Projects: List Mixpanel projects and workspaces available to the user.
tool_descriptions.Get-Events: Browse or search events in a project, optionally with full metadata.
tool_descriptions.List-Properties: List or search event and user properties in a project.
tool_descriptions.Search-Entities: Search dashboards, reports, experiments, feature flags, and other Mixpanel entities.
tool_descriptions.Create-Dashboard: Create a dashboard with text cards and reports. This changes Mixpanel.
tool_descriptions.Get-Dashboard: Read a dashboard's metadata, text cards, and reports.
tool_descriptions.Update-Dashboard: Change a dashboard's metadata, rows, or layout. This changes Mixpanel.
